title: Table 2.2 metres at the Table 2.1 storey limit (derived)
notes: Derived, not printed: the Table 2.2 relative height for each Table 2.1 storey limit (4 = 15 m, 6 = 21 m, 8 = 27 m, 12 = 39 m, 16 = 51 m, 20 = 63 m). Table 2.2 is indicative (DG 2.2.1); A2.2.1 is expressed in storeys. Rows also match the current names (R-AC4 = LR1, R-AC3 = MR2, R-AC1 = HR1, R-AC0 = R-PA; register C4P2-017). R-AC2 has no column and no row. The generic LR, MR and HR bands have no row (MR and HR each span columns with different values), so a site coded only LR, MR or HR is NOT_APPLICABLE until its code is known.
